title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Piazza Degli Scacchi, Marostica | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Piazza Degli Scacchi in Marostica, Italy, on 9 July 2018.

Marostica. Like all good shows we all ended up jumping. peace and love. ?????????????? pic.twitter.com/3fWzpqJHbc

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) July 9, 2018

It was the 22nd show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
